top_signals.title: Iran condemns U.S. plans to announce new sanctions
top_signals.summary: The secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, Mohsen Rezaei, told state television that Tehran would target the interests of countries helping the United States.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
